property.name: TemporaryStagingPath
property.summary: Optional path used when finite streamed content must be spooled locally before segmented upload.

property.name: CompletionMode
property.summary: Controls how one-call stream uploads decide when to stop.

property.name: MaxBytes
property.summary: Optional byte limit applied when the completion mode uses a bounded length.

property.name: PublishFinalStreamHash
property.summary: Controls whether stream-family commits should publish a final full-stream SHA-512 when the client can produce one. Defaults to true.

property.name: RequestedSegmentSizePolicy
property.summary: Optional requested segment size policy. The server may clamp or replace it and returns the effective policy in session state.
